timing_scope: Fresh solver subprocess wall time including imports, data loading, training and inference. Downloads and scorer excluded. Shared local Windows host; each configuration measured once.

selection_protocol.robot: Split only official train by robot: seed 20261016, 48000 training / 12000 independent holdout. Select HGB on holdout before evaluating leaderboard A/B. No fitting or hyperparameter tuning used A/B labels. After the mixed final result, the release conservatively retained the original MLP default; see robot_release_decision.
selection_protocol.order: Use public/pretrain only for development. Public/pretest and leaderboard A/B answers remain scorer-only.

split_mapping.public/pretest: A public-test slice, not the full original public test: Robot 600 rows, Order 20 dialogues.

downloads.note: Download wall time was not measured separately. It is excluded from every solver measurement.
downloads.recovered_failure: Subagent network DNS permission failure; parent downloaded identical pinned revisions under its network grant.
downloads.additional_recovered_failure: First parallel Order A/B download failed with Windows PermissionError during parent-directory creation. Retried after serially creating all file and metadata directories; pinned files were reused.

input_integrity_checks.conclusion: Original public file has inconsistent RIFF length. Download and evaluation copy match independently fetched official bytes. No file was repaired or altered.
input_integrity_checks.etag_note: HF local cache metadata ETag is distinct from the remote response ETag; neither is assumed to be a universal file hash.

setup_failures: First Order prefix-only B dispatch occurred before the data-layout copy finished and failed before solver launch because the scorer answer file was not yet present. No score or solver runtime was produced for that dispatch; retry used the completed layout.
robot_observation: HGB selected on train holdout gains 1.775 percentage points there, but final A loses 1.1667 points and final B gains 0.5833 points versus MLP. No consistent final-evaluation improvement is established. No further tuning or ensembling followed A/B evaluation.
robot_release_decision: Keep the original MLP default because the proposed replacement did not demonstrate consistent independent improvement. HGB remains an explicit --model hist option. This conservative release decision was made after observing the mixed final results; those results are not claimed as an untouched validation of this release decision.
post_measurement_fixes: Robot exception path preserves already-saved partial predictions. All listed completed Robot runs finished without that exception path.

order_development_diagnostic.note: Development-only speaker clustering diagnostic, not the contest ordering metric.
